metadata.name: claude
metadata.description: (prompt, key [, model]) - ask Claude; the reply becomes the cell value (REACTIVE: edit the prompt to re-ask). key accepts a wallet SecretHandle from apiKey("anthropic") (resolved at the fetch site, never stored) or a literal sk-ant-… string. Default model claude-fable-5. =claude(chat!A1, apiKey("anthropic"))

metadata.name: llm.chat
metadata.description: (prompt, key [, model] [, url]) - a generic OpenAI-shaped chat completion; returns the reply text. Host chat()/grok() verbs delegate here.

metadata.name: makeclient
metadata.description: (provider, key, model?) — capture an llm client from a key (claude/grok). Returns a CLIENT HANDLE whose VALUE shows status (non-secret): status 'ready' when the resolved key is real, else status 'error' + error '✗ no key'. The key is NEVER in the value (it lives in a keystore); the grid shows e.g. 'claude ✓ ready' / 'grok ✗ no key'. =makeclient("claude", apiKey("anthropic"))

metadata.name: client.send
metadata.description: (client, message) — send a message via a captured client; resolves the key at the effect site

metadata.name: clientlight
metadata.description: (client) — a dom 🟢 (ready) / 🔴 (error) indicator reading the client's non-secret `status`. A FOCUSED helper: the boot's chat is assembled from a few plain dom() formula cels (a bots-left dom, a history dom, an input+send dom) that call this + chathistory — there is no all-in-one chatpanel verb. =clientlight(clients.A1)

metadata.name: messages
metadata.description: (from1, text1, …) — build a message LIST [{from, text}, …] (renders as JSON in the grid). A convenience constructor; the chat conversation cell (clients.C1) now seeds as a plain empty value, and chat.cellsend appends to it via setValue. =messages("system", "ask the bots anything")

metadata.name: chathistory
metadata.description: (messages) — a scrollable dom rendering of a [{from, text}, …] message list; one bubble per message, the sender labeled. Renders a centered starter line ('ask the bots anything…') when the list is empty or not an array. A FOCUSED helper called by the boot's history dom cel — the chat is a few plain dom() formula cels, not one chatpanel verb. =chathistory(clients.C1)

metadata.name: chat.cellinput
metadata.description: (state, payload, event) — the chat entry's `input` handler: stash the live typed text (event.target.value) into the clients.D1 buffer cel. Lets the input be an UNCONTROLLED field authored purely with (on "input" "chat.cellinput") inside a plain dom() formula — the on-verb only emits dispatch bindings, so this is how typing reaches the D1 buffer that chat.cellsend reads. Replaces the {set}/extract listener the removed chatpanel verb baked in.

metadata.name: chat.cellsend
metadata.description: (state) — chat send handler: append the clients.D1 text to the messages cell (clients.C1) as {from:'me'}, ask the first armed client, and append its reply. The message list + entry are CELS the graph owns. clients.C1 seeds as a plain VALUE cell (empty string in the boot formula), so every append is a plain setValue write of the grown array — never setCel/structure churn. That structure churn previously re-materialized the clients genesis and swept the clients.D1 entry cel, throwing 'setValue: unknown cel clients.D1' on the second send; with a value-seeded C1 the entry cel survives across sends.

metadata.name: chat.cellkey
metadata.description: (state, payload, event) — Enter in the chat entry fires chat.cellsend.

metadata.name: clientsheet
metadata.description: genesis: a sheet of llm clients made from the wallet (clients.claude/clients.grok = makeclient(provider, apiKey(...))). =clientsheet()
